satellite_remote_sensing_radar.provider: European Space Agency (ESA) Copernicus Programme & Google Earth Engine (GEE)
satellite_remote_sensing_radar.water_detection_threshold: < -16.5 dB backscatter (specular reflection of radar waves away from antenna over standing open water)
satellite_remote_sensing_radar.dem_slope_mask: SRTM 30m slope < 5 degrees (eliminates mountain radar shadow false positives)
satellite_remote_sensing_radar.data_utilized: Automated cloud-penetrating water detection pipeline during heavy monsoon cloud cover.

scientific_engineering_methodology.citation: Froehlich, D.C. (2008). 'Embankment Dam Breach Parameters and Their Uncertainties.' ASCE Journal of Hydraulic Engineering, 134(12), 1708-1721. DOI: 10.1061/(ASCE)0733-9429(2008)134:12(1708)

equations.peak_discharge: Qp = Cd * [Bavg * hb^1.5 + (8/15) * z * sqrt(2g) * hb^2.5] [m3/s]

scientific_engineering_methodology.method: Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) Lagrangian Fluid Mechanics
scientific_engineering_methodology.citation: Monaghan, J.J. (1992). 'Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics.' Annual Review of Astronomy and Astrophysics; Violeau, D., & Rogers, B.D. (2016). 'SPH for free-surface flows.' Journal of Hydraulic Research.
scientific_engineering_methodology.formulation: Near-field violent kinetic jet: v0 = sqrt(2 * g * hw); Gaussian cross-stream momentum dispersion sigma = sigma0 + k_disp * d.

scientific_engineering_methodology.citation: Deltares (2022). 'Delft3D-FLOW User Manual: Simulation of multi-dimensional hydrodynamic flows and transport phenomena.' Delft, The Netherlands.
scientific_engineering_methodology.formulation: Manning flow velocity v = (1/n) * Rh^(2/3) * S0^(1/2); Wave celerity c = 1.45 * v; Lateral floodplain diffusion W(d) = max(60 + 12d + 25h, 40m).

scientific_engineering_methodology.citation: National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) Dam Break Emergency Action Plan Guidelines; US Bureau of Reclamation (USBR) ACER Technical Memorandum No. 11.

thresholds.high_danger_red: Water depth h >= 2.5 m OR Flow velocity v >= 5.0 m/s (Structural destruction, impassable evacuation routes)
thresholds.low_danger_yellow: Water depth 0.3 m <= h < 2.5 m (Overbank floodplain diffusion, waterlogging, advisory evacuation)
thresholds.safe_havens_green: Elevated terrain >= 25 m above valley floor, situated 100% outside maximum flood hazard contour

dams.name: Rishi Ganga Rock/Ice Dam (Chamoli 2021)

structural_parameters.failure_mode_description: Massive rock/ice avalanche dam impoundment and sudden outburst (kO=1.3, z=1.0)

dams.historical_context: Site of the Feb 2021 Chamoli disaster where a rock/ice avalanche dammed the Rishi Ganga and catastrophically breached, causing sudden high-velocity flash floods downstream.

emergency_protocols: Issue immediate Level-3 Flash Flood Red Alert to downstream district collectors.
Evacuate all settlements within 0-10 km zone (lead time under 45 minutes).
Shutdown downstream hydel power intakes and secure electrical substations.
Deploy National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) boats at designated staging ghats.
Establish relief centers at elevations at least 20m above current river water line.
